item.summary: K33 AB (publ) has entered into a conditional agreement with Reverion Capital AB (publ) worth SEK 13 million, according to a company notice on 16 November 2026. Subject to completion, about 26,000 K33 shareholders would receive Reverion shares worth SEK 5 million as a dividend in kind, and Reverion would issue an SEK 8 million interest-free, unsecured, subordinated convertible loan to K33. The deal requires approval at an extraordinary general meeting of K33 and sufficient free equity, and either party may terminate the agreement if the conditions have not been met by 31 December 2026.
